# Tigre Del Barrio Tire Shop

> Neighborhood llantera at 1710 Montopolis Dr, Austin, Texas. Fast flat repairs, new and used tires and rims on Montopolis Dr near the airport. Open 7 AM to 10 PM Monday to Saturday and 7 AM to 6 PM on Sunday. Pull in or call.

- Phone: (737) 368-5380
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Montopolis, Del Valle, East Austin, Garfield
- Google rating: 4.8 from 57 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/tigre-del-barrio-tire-shop/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/tigre-del-barrio-tire-shop/book.html

## Services
- Flat repair: Nail, screw or a piece of metal in the tread? Pull in and we'll patch it and get you back on the road, even late.
- New tires: Stacks of new tires out front, including Milestar. Tell us your size and we'll check what's on the lot.
- Used tires: Good used tires with the size chalked right on the sidewall, for when you need one tire or a set.
- Rims & wheels: Rims on display at the shop, plus mounting new or used tires on your wheels.
- Tune-ups, brakes & oil: It's right there on the banner out front: tune-ups, brakes and oil changes.
- Truck & trailer tires: Lifted trucks and work trailers too. Flats on a trailer axle don't scare us.

## About
Tigre Del Barrio is a neighborhood tire shop, a llantera, at 1710 Montopolis Dr in southeast Austin, close to the airport. Look for the red TUNE-UPS, BRAKES, OIL CHANGE banners, the Milestar awning, the OPEN sign and tires stacked high along the fence. We fix flats, sell new and used tires and rims, and handle tune-ups, brakes and oil changes. Used tires have their size chalked right on the sidewall so you can see what's on the lot. We're open 7 AM to 10 PM Monday to Saturday and 7 AM to 6 PM on Sunday. Customers tell the same story: they got a flat after hours, found us still open, and were back on the road fast at a fair price.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How late are you open?
  A: Monday to Saturday 7 AM to 10 PM, Sunday 7 AM to 6 PM. Hours can change on holidays, so call (737) 368-5380 if you're cutting it close.
- Q: Do I need an appointment for a flat?
  A: No. Pull in to 1710 Montopolis Dr and we'll take a look. Customers say we got them in right away, even near closing time.
- Q: Do you sell used tires?
  A: Yes. New and used tires are stacked on the lot with the size chalked on each one. Call with your size (it's on the sidewall) and we'll check.
- Q: I just landed at the airport with a flat. How far are you?
  A: We're on Montopolis Dr in southeast Austin, a short drive from the airport, and open later than most shops nearby.
- Q: Where are you exactly?
  A: 1710 Montopolis Dr, Austin, TX 78741, in Montopolis in southeast Austin. Look for the red banners, the Milestar awning and the OPEN sign.
- Q: Can my car be towed to you?
  A: Yes. Customers have had their car towed in after a blowout and gotten a replacement tire the same night. Call ahead so we know you're coming.
